text: The Patriots' Thursday night trip to Chicago ended in a 30-24 defeat, with Caleb Williams and the Bears securing Round 2 of what's apparently becoming a rivalry between the two young quarterbacks, as Drake Maye and New England's offense couldn't quite keep pace despite some bright individual performances. Rhamondre Stevenson reached a career-high in receiving yards and continues to do the little things right for the offense, sitting on the cusp of 100 carries for the sixth straight season, though the Patriots were already playing short-handed up front with starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown ruled out due to injuries before the game even kicked off. Head Coach Mike Vrabel and his players had plenty to digest from the loss, and the beat writers catalogued eight key takeaways from Thursday's TNF thriller that will inform how New England approaches the rest of its season.
